title: Steadfast reserve command strip — compact controls for GPU pool health and burst
creator: Lina Gomez
description: Design a compact, single-line 'command strip' that surfaces critical GPU pool health signals and exposes lightweight controls for autoscale and burst settings. The strip is intended for the top of the Dedicated Capacity detail view and must: (1) show immediate health status (OK/Degraded/Critical) with a sparkline and short ETA for recovery, (2) surface an autoscale policy quick-toggle and preview, (3) include a burst dial for short-term capacity at an estimated cost delta, and (4) expose a compact overflow menu for full policy composer and rollout actions. The goal is to reduce operator cognitive load during incident triage and make common adjustments from a single focused UI affordance.
acceptance_criteria: Strip appears at top of Dedicated Capacity detail for pools with >=1 node
Health state computed from p95 latency and GPU utilization thresholds
BurstDial opens inline preview showing cost delta and estimated tokens/sec increase
Autoscale quick-toggle respects pool-level hysteresis and fallback policies
All actions logged to audit trail and emit telemetry events
Mobile/responsive layout collapses to icon-only with menu
design_notes: Chose single-line strip to avoid context switching from the main dashboard — keeps operators focused on triage-to-action flow.
Health sparkline uses rolling 15m window; color mapped to severity tiers used across Console for consistency.
BurstDial is intentionally coarse-grained (Low/Medium/High) to prevent micro-bursting and to surface clear cost estimates.
Autoscale quick-toggle will show a tooltip with active policy name and a one-click 'Dry-run' that simulates scaling without committing.
We prioritized an explicit confirm step for burst to reduce accidental spend during incidents.
Accessibility: all controls reachable by keyboard; burst dial provides ARIA labels conveying cost delta.
Trade-off: compact UI reduces surface for advanced options; overflow menu leads to full policy composer for edge cases.

risks: Misleading cost estimates if backend cost model lags real usage — mitigation: show timestamp and confidence band
Operators may overuse burst causing transient capacity headroom issues — mitigation: coarse burst presets and cooldown windows
Telemetry gaps if events not instrumented properly — mitigation: feature gated rollout with telemetry validation step
